# tplink_router (Data Source)

Router runtime status: WAN/LAN addresses, uptime, resource usage, and client counts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tplink_router" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `conn_type` (String) WAN connection type (dhcp, pppoe, static, ...).
- `cpu_usage` (Number) CPU usage ratio (0-1).
- `devices_total` (Number) Total connected devices.
- `guest_wireless_total` (Number) Wireless clients on guest networks.
- `iot_wireless_total` (Number) Wireless clients on IoT networks.
- `lan_dhcp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the LAN DHCP server is enabled.
- `lan_ip` (String) LAN IPv4 address.
- `lan_mac` (String) LAN interface MAC address.
- `mem_usage` (Number) Memory usage ratio (0-1).
- `wan_gateway` (String) WAN gateway address.
- `wan_ip` (String) WAN IPv4 address.
- `wan_mac` (String) WAN interface MAC address.
- `wan_uptime` (Number) WAN connection uptime in seconds.
- `wired_total` (Number) Wired clients.
- `wireless_total` (Number) Wireless clients on host networks.
